# Copilot Instructions

## Design and Accessibility Rules

- Never use `text-white` on any element that has a brand background color (for example: `bg-brand-teak`, `bg-brand-clay`, `bg-brand-sand`, `bg-brand-mint`, `bg-brand-slate`).
- Always use `text-black` for text on brand-colored backgrounds.
- If a component currently uses `text-white` on a brand-colored background, replace it with `text-black`.
